concurrency.runtime: concurrent compile/instantiate/execute on distinct objects is race-tested
concurrency.compiledModule: compile once and instantiate many; blanket method-level goroutine-safety is not yet documented

concurrency.separateInstances: eligible independent instances may execute native code concurrently by default; cross-instance dependencies or shared execution state can require the process-wide lease
concurrency.nativeExecutionParallelism: instance-local leases for eligible independent instances; process-wide fallback for dependent execution
concurrency.resultLifetime: instance-owned result buffer remains valid only until the next call
